## Work Experience

### Airbnb — Senior Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure & AI Engineering (Sep 2024 – Present)
- Built BPI Virtual Analyst: 5-step LLM wizard integrating 30+ models (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama), used by ~55 analysts. Scaled from 600 → 10,000 rows/run.
- Built Presidio PII pipeline (30% faster detection). Led Redpen label export upgrade targeting 80% runtime reduction.
- Stack: Python, Streamlit, Flask, Celery, Airflow, Labelbox, Presidio, AWS, OpenTelemetry

### Eli Lilly — Lead Senior Software Engineer (Contractor) — Dose Management Platform (21 CFR Part 11) (Feb 2024 – Aug 2024)
- Dose Management System for clinical trials. SAP migration. 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, React, SAP, PostgreSQL, Azure

### Southwest Airlines — Senior Software Engineer (Contractor) — Backend & Data Platform (Jan 2023 – Jan 2024)
- Flight dispatch system handling 4M requests/min. Distributed lock for flight assignment.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS

### Shell — Senior Software Engineer (Contractor) — Backend & Data Science (Jun 2021 – Dec 2022)
- NLP platform processing 17M pageviews/month. Accuracy 86% → 94%. ML framework published at SPE ADIPEC 2022.
- Stack: Python, TensorFlow, Kubernetes, AWS SageMaker, Docker

### Oracle — Software Engineer, ERP Analytics & Data Engineering (Aug 2017 – Jul 2019)
- ERP analytics across P2P + O2C for 13 business units. Workflow automation.
- Stack: Java, Oracle DB, PL/SQL, Kafka, Spring Boot
